record.t: Was elected Idaho's 44th Lieutenant Governor in November 2022 and took office on January 6, 2023.
record.q: The people of Idaho elected Scott Bedke as the state’s 44 th Lieutenant Governor in November 2022. He officially took office on January 6, 2023.

record.t: Won the 2022 election for lieutenant governor of Idaho against Democratic nominee Pickens.
record.q: Pickens previously ran as the Democratic nominee for lieutenant governor in 2022, when she lost to Republican candidate Scott Bedke by 34 points.
